title: What if your original ball is out of bounds or not found?
question: You play a provisional ball. Your original ball is later found to be out of bounds, or you don't find it within 3 minutes. What should you do next?

choices.text: The provisional ball becomes your ball in play, with a 1-stroke penalty
You must replay your shot from the previous spot with no penalty
You can choose to play either ball with no penalty
You must drop a new ball where the original went out of bounds, with a 2-stroke penalty

explanation: If your original ball is out of bounds or lost (not found within 3 minutes), the provisional ball becomes the ball in play and you count a one-stroke penalty.
